desc: Derive the incremental wrap-update formula and delta[v] = sum(2*i - 1 - N) for positions with value v.
Implement Fenwick-tree initial inversion count for A in O(N log M).
Implement delta array construction in O(N) using 1-based positions and 64-bit-safe integers.
Implement the sweep over k=0..M-1 with update index (M-1-k) % M and newline-separated output.
Verify correctness on samples and edge cases such as N=1, M=1, all equal values, and strictly increasing/decreasing sequences.
